capture.source: dev Paired Capture (DevPairedCapture) — same RoomScene3D scene/camera, base then structuralPass; offline, no fal call

pairing_guarantees.same_camera: guaranteed by construction (both passes render the same scene room with the deterministic fixed camera; structural is the wireframe pass of that frame)

note: Structural image is a geometry reference captured for the A/B/C benchmark. No live fal call was made. Arm C uses structural.png as control_lora_image_url; Arms A/B use base.png.
hash_note: All sha256 are of the raw on-disk file bytes; prompt.txt normalized to LF so the hash is reproducible cross-platform (the earlier CRLF write made the file-byte hash differ from the recorded content hash).
